title: On the Grothendieck Ring of Finite-Dimensional Non-Degenerate Evolution Algebras
summary: We study the Grothendieck ring of finite-dimensional non-degenerate evolution algebras over a field $\mathbb{K}$, with addition induced by direct sum and multiplication induced by tensor product. Although its underlying abelian group is freely generated by indecomposable isomorphism classes, the ring structure is much smaller: tensor products create systematic non-cancellation phenomena and many zero-divisors.
